title: planning_region
description: A governed Kansas Regional Advisory Committee (RAC) planning area identity. Kansas has exactly 14 RAC planning areas. The kwo-rac-01 through kwo-rac-14 identifiers use the KFM identity inventory's stable ordinal and are not claimed to be KWO-native numeric identifiers. Missing or unresolvable geometry and county crosswalks remain explicit unresolved states.

region_id.description: Stable KFM identity for this RAC planning area: exactly kwo-rac-01 through kwo-rac-14.

name.description: Source-grounded official name of the RAC planning region.

rac_number.description: KFM stable ordinal 1–14 assigned by the governed RAC identity inventory; not a claim of a KWO-native number.

geometry_ref.description: Reference to a governed region-geometry authority record, or null while unresolved. Geometry is never embedded here.

geometry_confidence.description: Reference resolution state. Approximate and confirmed require a non-null authority-backed geometry_ref; missing or unverified geometry remains unresolved.

county_crosswalk_ref.description: Reference to a governed county-crosswalk authority record, or null while unresolved. County membership is not embedded here.

source_ref.description: Reference to the governed KWO identity-authority record.
